done_when: When a review is clean but lists findings, close says in one plain line that they do not block and why, and a Not done that names one of the item's own Done-when lines blocks the merge
why: Close lists P1 findings, including a Not done on the fix's own Done-when, and then says Review: clean without saying that these findings do not block, so the agent merges unmet work without knowing (issue #927).
